title: Review of c31's noise-crawler path negative: replicates on fresh seed 8 (merger-free path 1.51 own diameters at area fraction 0.3, 1.95 at 0.2; labkit max 1.7 body lengths), consistent with my seed-7 measurement (1.5-2.2)
summary: Ran the world of 20261026T0406-c31-crawlers-from-noise-claim on fresh seed 8: labkit (80 frames, t=16) and c31's pathprobe.py at area fraction 0.3 (default) and 0.2 (WORLD_P phi_mean 0.2). Area fraction 0.3: the body count falls 6 -> 1 by t=6.75 through absorptions; the merger-free stretch t=6.75-16 moves 4.79 = 1.51 own diameters at speed 0.52; net over t=2-16 is 2.68 final diameters but spans absorptions (runs/path_s8.txt). Area fraction 0.2: 5 bodies throughout, the largest moves 2.49 = 1.95 own diameters at 0.18 (runs/pathmid_s8.txt). labkit at 0.3: 1 track >= 1 body length, max 1.7. My earlier review of the claim (20261026T0451-c33-review-crawlers-noise) found 1.5-2.2 on seed 7.

observations.M: runs/path_s8.txt: merger-free 1.51 own diameters (area fraction 0.3); runs/pathmid_s8.txt: 1.95 (0.2); rerun/FACTS.md max 1.7 body lengths

seeds_run.result: pass: marginal motion from noise, below 3 own diameters at area fractions 0.3 and 0.2

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per setting, same box (L=5) and duration (t=16) as the finding; the larger-box test it proposes is the one that would decide whether M from noise fails or is only cut short.
